_doc: Pre-registered rule changes for the rule-change experiment (research_log #39, V16).
Fixed before any rule-change result was computed; chosen as plausible policy changes in both directions that move the level of test images (counts from the descriptions only).
R1: 48 test images change level (all upward); R2: 43 (all downward, creates 24 Level-three images); R3: 16 (downward).
